audit.whatIsWrong: diff read HARD while diffRating was 4/10 and report[14] called it a favoured matchup.
audit.why: Three fields answered the same question three ways on one page.
audit.corrected: diff set to FAVOURED, matching the 4/10 rating, the green tone and the report line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Tryndamere six rows and a skill row at 6, against a 45.9% win rate, and the whys contradicted the sides on rows 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7.
audit.why: Level 6 is genuinely Tryndamere's — first Riftwalk is 500 range for 40 mana and cannot be chained, while Undying Rage is new. The late rows are where 45.9% comes from: Riftwalk falls to a 2-second cooldown at rank 3 and he simply leaves.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Skill / Kassadin in both layers, ratings and whys rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's core instruction was 'engage only on Riftwalk's cooldown', and spikes[0] claimed Null Sphere's shield mattered against your crits.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2 seconds — there is no cooldown window to wait for; his mana bar is the real limiter. Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage, so it absorbs none of your physical crit damage. Void Stone also ignores unit collision, so minions never body-block him.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, spikes[0] and spikes[1] rewritten around Riftwalk's mana cost, Force Pulse's 21s cooldown and 400-range cone, and Nether Blade's 7s auto reset as the burst tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown' applied to Riftwalk.
audit.why: Its full cooldown is two to five seconds.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now points at his mana instead.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riftwalk: 5s at rank 1, 2s at rank 3 — his mana bar is the real cooldown, so make him spend it. - Force Pulse: 21s at rank 1, a 400-range cone he must charge before it exists. - Undying Rage: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Kassadin's Riftwalk: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. When it is down — Spin in, crit him down.
edits.after: Nether Blade is an auto reset, 7s — the wind-up is the tell, step out on it. Void Stone means minions never body-block his approach.

edits.before: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1, 2s at rank 3 — mana, not cooldown, is what stops him blinking.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Riftwalk is back in seconds — waiting on that cooldown never comes.

edits.before: Kassadin's Q Null Sphere shields him from your magic-free crits' spell interrupt and his W Nether Blade sustains his mana, but he has no mobility pre-6 and his early damage is weak; you should be all-inning him repeatedly with E Spinning Slash and Q Bloodlust autos to deny his scaling before Riftwalk exists.
edits.after: Null Sphere's shield only absorbs magic damage, so it eats none of your crits, and Nether Blade is a 7s auto reset that refunds his mana — its wind-up is your cue to step out. He has no mobility before 6, so all-in him with Spinning Slash and Bloodlust autos and deny his scaling before Riftwalk exists.

edits.before: Your level-6 window is critical: Kassadin gets R Riftwalk to blink away, but the very first cast is cheap and short-ranged, so if you E in and Undying Rage you can often kill him before he stacks enough Riftwalks to escape; this is your last easy kill before he spikes.
edits.after: Your level-6 window is critical: Riftwalk blinks only 500 units for 40 mana, and each extra cast in quick succession costs far more, so if you E in and Undying Rage he runs out of mana before he runs out of your reach. This is your last easy kill before he spikes.

edits.before: Kill him at level 6 before Riftwalk stacks refund the cost
edits.after: Kill him at 6 while Riftwalk is still 500 range on 40 mana

notes: The page told the reader to 'engage only on Riftwalk's cooldown' in half a dozen places; Riftwalk's cooldown is 2-5 seconds, so that advice is empty. I corrected the interaction fields, but focus.text, loading, winCon, tldr, breakdown.mid and report[9] all still frame the lane around tracking Riftwalk's cooldown and would need the same treatment — they are prose I could not rephrase inside the length band without dropping the fury/pattern content the user approved. Per the mirror, 'unkillable for 5 seconds' is not published by Riot; I used 'while it runs' where I rewrote, and left the existing instances alone.
